Chapter 973 Chapter 28: Changes In The Myriad Realms Gate (Subscription Request)

Chapter 973  Chapter 28: Changes in the Myriad Realms Gate (Subscription Request)

Chikun Star Domain, Dawn Star System, Canglan Star.

A figure appeared silently, it was Lin Yuan.

"Canglan Star." Lin Yuan looked at the inconspicuous planet not far away, feeling quite emotional.

Canglan Star is just a Middle-grade Life Planet, even though it had been transformed into a high-grade Life Planet because of his influence, to Lin Yuan, it still felt like dust.

But this place was ultimately where Lin Yuan grew up, and his parents still lived on Canglan Star to this day.

"It's been a long time since I've come back." Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Since leaving Canglan Star and heading to Chikun Main Star, Lin Yuan had not returned, their meetings with parents were also held in the Virtual World.

...

Canglan Star, Central Continent, within Manor No. 1.

Lin Shoucheng and his wife Lu Qiong were planting flowers; with the technology of human civilization, any exotic flower could be rapidly cultivated, but Lu Qiong liked the feeling of flowers slowly growing.

"Old Lin, I've seen many people saying Xiaoyuan has become the ultimate strong?" Lu Qiong said in surprise after taking care of the flowers.

"Xiaoyuan has become the ultimate strong?"

Lin Shoucheng was startled, not long ago he was still dazed by his son overwhelmingly overpowering another ultimate strong, and now he has directly become one?

"Impossible, right?" Lin Shoucheng said subconsciously.

"It's true, an announcement was issued by the Central Star Domain." Lu Qiong immediately said, as virtual screens continuously appeared in front of her.

Just then.

A figure appeared not far away, smiling kindly at Lin Shoucheng and his wife Lu Qiong.

"Xiaoyuan."

Upon seeing this figure, Lin Shoucheng immediately exclaimed in surprise.

Compared to the time he left Canglan Star, Lin Yuan had hardly changed at this moment, even his clothes were the same, only his gaze and aura had deepened."

"Xiaoyuan, you're back too?"

Lu Qiong was filled with joy although they often met Lin Yuan in the Virtual World, it still couldn't compare to the reality.

"Mom and dad." Lin Yuan arrived casually with a smile.

"Xiaoyuan, everyone online says you've become the ultimate strong…" Lu Qiong chatted for a bit, then immediately brought up the matter.

Upon hearing this.

Lin Shoucheng immediately looked at Lin Yuan.

"Sort of." Lin Yuan nodded with a smile.

"Really became the ultimate strong?" Lin Shoucheng and his wife Lu Qiong looked at each other.

Their son had become the ultimate strong?

"Xiaoyuan, they say that the life essence of the ultimate strong transcends the river of time, do we look like ants in your eyes now?"

Lu Qiong couldn't help but ask.

"Hahaha..." Lin Yuan laughed out loud, "No, you two are different."

As long as it is life, there are emotions, Lin Yuan is no exception, his parents no matter how weak, are still his parents.

Just then.

Buzz buzz buzz～

A flying craft quickly descended.

Two figures walked down from it, it was Lin Yi and Xia Keran.

"Dad, mom, something big..." Lin Yi strode towards the manor, shouting as he walked, and Xia Keran was also full of excitement.

By the time they got into the manor and saw Lin Yuan standing aside, they were a bit stunned.

"Brother..." Lin Yi instinctively called out.

Xia Keran, standing behind Lin Yi, stared blankly at Lin Yuan, quickly recovering and immediately bowed deeply, "Xia Keran greets the ultimate strong."

As a major evolved family of human civilization, the Xia Family naturally knew right away about the Galaxy Master advancing to the twelfth tier, even obtaining verified news.

The reason Xia Keran and Lin Yi hurried to Canglan Star so quickly was precisely because of the Galaxy Master's advancement to the twelfth tier, wanting to share this joyous news with the Galaxy Master's parents.

Although in the age of the internet, by the time they arrived at Canglan Star, Lin Shoucheng and his wife probably already knew this news, but personally coming over also showed their attitude.

Now, Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong as parents of the ultimate strong.

It's just that Xia Keran did not expect Lin Yuan to also be here.

"Stand up," Lin Yuan said casually with a slight smile.

"Yes." Xia Keran was still very constrained, remembering the admonishment from the Xia Family's eleventh-layer ancestor before coming, to never display any improper behavior or actions in front of the Galaxy Master.

Xia Keran agreed with this greatly, after all, the Galaxy Master is now the ultimate strong, the tenth ultimate strong of human civilization, so highly esteemed.

"Brother, how did you come over?" Lin Yi's tone also grew much more cautious. The term 'ultimate strong' brought immense pressure.

Especially having just received this news, Lin Yi trembled at the thought that her brother had become the highly esteemed ultimate strong of human civilization, transcending above everything.

"Just had some time, so I came over." Lin Yuan said casually.

Before the final breakthrough, Lin Yuan had almost all his energy focused on training, because without advancing to the twelfth tier, he would die along with the collapse of the river of time.

Under such pressure, Lin Yuan naturally went all out.

But having become the ultimate strong, Lin Yuan was more relaxed.

The ultimate strong has infinite lifespan, the only issue being the need to face the great cosmic destruction, but with Lin Yuan's strength, he could easily overcome it.

...

Inside the manor.

Lin Shoucheng and his wife Lu Qiong, along with Lin Yi, Xia Keran, and Lin Yuan, were casually chatting.

Outside the manor, many evolved guards meticulously patrolled.

As parents of the Galaxy Master, Lin Shoucheng and his wife Lu Qiong naturally received protection from a professional team to prevent any danger.

"Miss Lin Yi and Mr. Xia have come back."

The guard captain glanced at the incoming aircraft and nodded to let it pass.

Lin Shoucheng and his wife held high ranks, and unrelated individuals were forbidden to approach, but as the sister of the Galaxy Master, Miss Lin Yi naturally had clearance.

The guard captain watched Lin Yi and Xia Keran enter the manor, and soon he faintly heard conversations from inside.

"Hmm?"

The guard captain took a brief look, then froze on the spot.

Because at that moment in the manor, besides Lin Shoucheng and his wife, Lin Yi and Xia Keran, there was also a man standing there quietly.

This man had entered without leaving any trace or record, and the guard captain did not remember seeing this man entering recently.

"Not good, an unknown character has appeared, might pose a threat..." The guard captain's heartbeat began to accelerate, under his protection, if anything happened to Lin Shoucheng and his wife, he dared not think of the consequences.

"Alert, initiate highest security!"

The guard captain immediately notified all evolved guards.

Suddenly, a large number of evolved guards appeared outside the manor, closely monitoring the situation inside.

"Captain..." Just as the guard captain was considering his next actions, suddenly a voice came from beside.

"What do you want to say?" The guard captain looked towards him.

"He, he seems to be the Galaxy Master..." The speaking evolved guard stammered a bit.

Those who could become guards here, all had extensive experience, but still felt somewhat dazed under the tremendous shock of seeing the Galaxy Master in person.

"The Galaxy Master?"

The guard captain fell silent.

He looked back towards the inside of the manor, and noticed that the man bore a striking resemblance to the Galaxy Master.

Plus considering the conversational tone between Lin Shoucheng, his wife, Lin Yi, and Xia Keran, the guard captain immediately realized that he might have really misunderstood.

"The Galaxy Master, is that the Galaxy Master?"

"The Galaxy Master has actually appeared here?"

The guards immediately became restless, many evolved guards seemed incredibly excited; they had never seen such a formidable figure in their life, and now, it was the Galaxy Master?

...

...

Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky.

All experienced a huge change because Lin Yuan ascended to the Twelfth Layer.

Yu Race Territory.

An ordinary planet.

Many members of the Yu Race were migrating.

To face the upcoming purge and wrath of the Galaxy Master, including the Yu Race, Eleven Peak Clans must abandon most of their territories.

"Mom, Dad, do we really have to leave here?"

A young member of the Yu Race felt reluctant, even though the Yu Race powerhouses had explained that moving to the Yu Sergeants' core territory would provide a higher quality of life.

But after all, this was the place where they grew up.

The living habits of the Yu Race were similar to human civilization; they too cherished their homeland deeply.

"We must leave."

A nearby elder Yu spoke up, nodding: "The Galaxy Master ascended to the Twelfth Layer, if we do not leave now, when the Galaxy Master comes, we will be unable to leave."

"Is the Galaxy Master so terrifying, more than our Emperor?" the young Yu couldn't help saying.

Hearing this, the elder Yu did not respond.

He did not know whether the Galaxy Master or the Yu Emperor was stronger, but judging from the large-scale retreat of the entire Yu Race, it was clear the Galaxy Master was stronger.

...

Not only the Yu Race, but the Tianyu Clan, the Yu Clan, and many other clans had also started a massive retreat.

Lin Yuan merely ascended to the Twelfth Layer, hadn't even taken action yet, and he had already caused such a reaction among many peak clan powers, one could imagine the deterrence he wielded.

...

Canglan Star.

Lin Yuan casually chatted with his parents for a bit and glanced outside of the manor.

With his perception, he naturally had control over every little detail outside the manor; the entire Chikun Star Domain and even human civilization were under his gaze.

The evolved guards outside the manor were incredibly excited because of him, and Lin Yuan couldn't bother to stop them.

Ever since he ascended to the Twelfth Layer, unless he made contact himself, even the three goddesses and the virtual world network could not cover him, and the evolved guards around the manor would not have known in advance of his arrival.

"I'm going back now."

Lin Yuan bid farewell to his parents and sister, and his figure vanished on the spot.

...

Under the starry sky.

Lin Yuan's figure reappeared.

"Myriad Realms Gate..." Lin Yuan's spirit trembled slightly.

After successfully making the ultimate leap, not only did the mysterious gourd begin to transform, but the Myriad Realms Gate also underwent transformation.

Unlike the mysterious gourd, the transformation of the Myriad Realms Gate was overall faint and shrouded in mist.

Lin Yuan could distinctly feel a tremendously majestic source of power connecting with the Myriad Realms Gate projection deep in his mind.

At this moment.

Lin Yuan noticed that the transformation of the Myriad Realms Gate had completely ended.

Gathering his spirit, Lin Yuan immediately immersed his mind into the depths of his consciousness.

Looking towards the transformed Myriad Realms Gate.

"What is that?"

Lin Yuan's pupils slightly contracted.
